user.description: Create a player for the local audio output. You can link Alarmo under Configure.

init.title: JackSignal
init.description: Upload clips in Media → My media. Use this menu to test them and choose which ones Alarmo should play.

menu_options.event: Assign sound to an Alarmo event
menu_options.preview: Test a sound on the jack

alarm.title: Link Alarmo
alarm.description: Choose your Alarmo panel. Clear the selection to disconnect it.

event_sound.title: Event sound and priority
event_sound.description: Choose a sound from My media. Clear the sound to remove the rule.

data.repeat: Repeat while the alarm is triggered

sensor.title: Choose a sensor
sensor.description: Choose any binary sensor, including sensors outside Alarmo. Set separate activation/opening and deactivation/closing sounds. Only disarmed mode and failed arming require a linked panel.

sensor_sound.title: Sensor sound and priority
sensor_sound.description:
Sensor: {sensor}. Current raw state: **{state}** (reopen this form to refresh).

**Each alert needs its own sound.** To play both, select an OPENING file and a CLOSING file; they may be the same. Always does not select a file.

States are suggested automatically for a new sensor. Home Assistant normally uses on = open and off = closed. Review other vocabularies: true/false does not guarantee physical polarity. You can change both states or enter distinct custom values. Saved choices are preserved when editing.

To leave an alert without a sound, select Never for that alert. To delete the rule, set both to Never and clear both files. Failed arming uses the OPENING sound.

data.failed_to_arm: Play when preventing Alarmo from arming
data.close_sound: CLOSING · Sound (select another or the same file)

preview.title: Test audio
preview.description: Choose a clip and submit to play it on the jack. {status}

dlna.title: DLNA: network and port
dlna.description: Choose an IPv4 address on an interface visible to Home Assistant (Ethernet, Wi-Fi or VPN). You can enter another address belonging to this host. For VPNs without multicast, disable SSDP discovery and add http://IP:PORT/description.xml in a sender supporting manual receivers. The VPN must allow connections in both directions and access to the audio URL. A VPN in another container may require a route to the local IP. The receiver has no password: use trusted networks only. Alarmo retains priority.

overview.title: Sound assignments

speech.title: Choose a sensor for speech
speech.description: Choose any Home Assistant sensor, without requiring Alarmo. Configure one speech rule per sensor; return here to edit it. A text-to-speech integration must already be configured.

speech_rule.title: Speech and conditions

direct.title: Send audio
direct.description: Audio only. Uses low priority (P0): higher-priority alerts and protected sirens are never interrupted. A new request replaces other low-priority playback. Stop affects only playback from this screen.

direct_upload.title: Upload audio file
direct_upload.description:
Choose a file up to 100 MB. Valid audio is saved in My media → jacksignal with a unique name, even if an alert blocks playback. Reuse or delete it from My media. Select the file again after a failed request. {status}

✓ = playback accepted; it does not confirm audible output. Contents are checked: video and files without audio are rejected. Album artwork is allowed.

direct_url.title: Play audio URL
direct_url.description:
Paste a direct HTTP(S) audio or radio URL reachable from Home Assistant. Spotify or YouTube web pages are not audio URLs. The URL is not saved in configuration. {status}

✓ = playback accepted; it does not confirm audible output. Contents are checked: video and files without audio are rejected. Album artwork is allowed.

direct_media.title: Choose from My media
direct_media.description:
Choose an audio file already saved in My media. {status}

✓ = playback accepted; it does not confirm audible output. Contents are checked: video and files without audio are rejected. Album artwork is allowed.

dlna_status.title: DLNA diagnostics

error.local_sound_required: Choose an existing audio file from My media.
error.dlna_address: Check the LAN IPv4, port and FFprobe installation.
error.dlna_start: Could not start DLNA. Check that the IP belongs to this host and the port is free.
error.speech_engine: Choose a speech engine. If none appear, configure a TTS integration first.
error.speech_failed: Could not generate or play speech. Check the sensor, TTS engine and Home Assistant internal URL.
error.sensor_sound_required: Select a sound for this alert or set its condition to Never.
error.same_sensor_states: Opening and closing states must be different.
error.invalid_sensor_state: Enter a valid state; unknown and unavailable are reserved for unavailable sensors.
error.direct_audio: Could not validate audio. Check the file or URL; video is not supported.
error.direct_unavailable: Could not access the file or start FFprobe/FFmpeg. Check storage and logs.
